name: Soft Beef Barbacoa Street Tacos with Warm Corn Tortillas
whyItWorks: Slow-simmered shredded barbacoa beef served in double warm soft corn tortillas provides gentle animal protein and easy gluten-free starch without frying oils.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Request no fresh cilantro-onion relish and no spicy red salsa. Accompany with plain Mexican rice.
